init.reason: Starts with no active version, process lock or staged target.

begin.reason: Only unlocked alive process with valid revision and permission can begin. Ordinary and explicit rollback choose distinct revision guards.

stageArchive.reason: Download separates verification admission, but per-invocation work roots and staged archive cleanup are absent.

verifyBytes.reason: Canonical tree and approved digest are checked, but equal rendered bytes versus equal pair identity have no distinct state.

noChange.reason: No byte-identical no-change outcome preserving active template identity.

retain.reason: Selected pair is appended, with no retained-directory reuse versus physical move outcome.

prepareLink.reason: Only retained verified target under a live lock may prepare relative-link activation.

activate.reason: Publication commits active target only under verified atomic relative rename.

confirmReadback.reason: Current committed target requires readback before complete.

printSuccess.reason: Completion and readback are represented, but success output and subsequent cleanup are not independently modeled.

failure.reason: Generic failure preserves active version, but no per-phase primary diagnostic and cleanup ordering.

linkFailure.reason: Phase can fail without committing, but temporary-link ownership/cleanup choice is missing.

readbackFailure.reason: Failure after commit leaves active pair at the committed target.

cleanup.reason: A failure flag is retained, but cleanup actions cannot record per-invocation roots, staged candidate removal or separate cleanup error.

finish.reason: Lock held through readback, but no separate command exit and cleanup result.

permission.reason: Permission is an evidence input at begin/verification rather than an idle authority observation.

olderTemplateNewerPolicyTest.reason: Template ancestry is ignored. Ordinary registry revision cannot decrease.

explicitRollbackTest.reason: Retained pair and current permission recheck precede rollback commit.

interruptedActivationTest.reason: Process loss before atomic commit leaves original active pair.

cleanupFailureAfterCommitTest.reason: Failure leaves committed target, but successful readback followed by cleanup failure remains conflated.

cleanupFailureThenSameVersionRetryTest.reason: Retry allowed after failure. Same pair reuse/no-change does not have its own effect path.

readbackFailureLeavesCommittedTargetTest.reason: Readback failure cannot roll back an already activated pair.

readbackFailureThenVerifiedRetryTest.reason: Re-verification allowed but retained reuse and a retry readback without re-publication are absent.

rollbackReadbackFailureKeepsRollbackComm.reason: A committed older retained target stays active on later failure.

failedTemporaryLinkCleanupRetainsOnlyOwn.reason: No owned artifact collection or selective cleanup.

retryReusesRetainedVersionTest.reason: Retains pair history but appends the same pair rather than modeling physical reuse.

refusalBeforeStagingCreatesNoTemporaryAr.reason: Pre-begin permission is gated, but there are no modeled roots/artifacts to assert untouched.
